title: Find the oldest female patient diagnosed with SLE who has a normal hemoglob
question: Find the oldest female patient diagnosed with SLE who has a normal hemoglobin level and an abnormal red blood cell count. Return her ID, sex, and 'yes' or 'no' as whether she had at least one laboratory test in 1994 with GOT within the normal range.

prediction.sql:
SELECT
    P.XCL_058,
    P.XCL_059,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory L
            WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
              AND STRFTIME('%Y', L.XCL_015) = '1994'
              AND L.XCL_021 BETWEEN 0 AND 40
        ) THEN 'yes'
        ELSE 'no'
    END
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L1
    ON P.XCL_058 = L1.XCL_014
WHERE P.XCL_064 = 'SLE'
  AND P.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND L1.XCL_032 BETWEEN 10 AND 17
  AND L1.XCL_019 NOT BETWEEN 4.0 AND 5.5
ORDER BY P.XCL_060 ASC
LIMIT 1

compiled_semantic_plan.candidate_sql:
SELECT
    P.XCL_058,
    P.XCL_059,
    CASE
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM Laboratory L
            WHERE L.XCL_014 = P.XCL_058
              AND STRFTIME('%Y', L.XCL_015) = '1994'
              AND L.XCL_021 BETWEEN 0 AND 40
        ) THEN 'yes'
        ELSE 'no'
    END
FROM Patient P
INNER JOIN Laboratory L1
    ON P.XCL_058 = L1.XCL_014
WHERE P.XCL_064 = 'SLE'
  AND P.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND L1.XCL_032 BETWEEN 10 AND 17
  AND L1.XCL_019 NOT BETWEEN 4.0 AND 5.5
ORDER BY P.XCL_060 ASC
LIMIT 1

SELECT 
    p.XCL_058 AS id,
    p.XCL_059 AS sex,
    CASE 
        WHEN EXISTS (
            SELECT 1 
            FROM Laboratory l 
            WHERE l.XCL_014 = p.XCL_058 
              AND strftime('%Y', l.XCL_015) = '1994' 
              AND l.XCL_020 BETWEEN 0 AND 40
        ) THEN 'yes' 
        ELSE 'no' 
    END AS has_normal_got_1994
FROM Patient p
JOIN Examination e ON p.XCL_058 = e.XCL_001
WHERE p.XCL_059 = 'F'
  AND e.XCL_006 = 'SLE'
  AND e.XCL_003 BETWEEN 12.0 AND 16.0
  AND e.XCL_004 NOT BETWEEN 4.0 AND 5.5
ORDER BY p.XCL_060 DESC
LIMIT 1
